entityDescription:
NEXOFAB™ is a cutting-edge clean-tech and deep-tech company specializing in the development of sustainable, high-performance building systems for a variety of industries, including construction, defense, and aerospace. Our innovative approach combines advanced manufacturing technologies like LSAM (Large Scale Additive Manufacturing), FDM (Fused Deposition Modeling), and CFAM (Continuous Fiber Additive Manufacturing) to produce efficient, eco-friendly building components and solutions.
At the core of NEXOFAB™'s mission is the creation of modular, energy-efficient, and scalable structures that contribute to the reduction of CO2 emissions, reduce material waste, and optimize production processes. Our focus is on enhancing the construction industry’s sustainability and performance by offering lightweight, customizable, and cost-effective solutions that meet the demands of both temporary and permanent structures.
Through the use of LSAM, we are able to create large-scale parts with exceptional precision and scalability. FDM is employed for rapid prototyping and small-scale production, enabling quick iteration and testing of complex designs. Additionally, CFAM integrates continuous fibers into the additive manufacturing process, providing superior strength, durability, and performance in parts for high-demand applications.
NEXOFAB™ is committed to revolutionizing the way we build, utilizing advanced technologies and innovative materials to deliver scalable, energy-efficient, and environmentally responsible solutions. With a focus on both R&D and market expansion, we aim to lead the transition to a more sustainable future in the built environment, defense, and aerospace sectors.

entityDescription:
AstaZero AB is a leading research facility in the field of automated and connected transport systems, operating a full-scale independent test environment for future automated transport systems. We offer comprehensive testing services for Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (AD/ADAS), including risk assessment, test method development, and scenario design. This support extends through the entire verification and validation process, ensuring that advanced safety systems function correctly in various traffic situations.
AstaZero maintains a digital twin of their proving ground, which is based on fused lidar, camera, and GNSS data. This allows for predictable and repeatable physical test performance from simulation toolchains. Additionally, we conduct accredited testing for UNECE requirements and Euro NCAP active safety rating tests, including AD grading and truck testing.
In the domain of Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) technologies, AstaZero utilizes precise positioning to ensure accurate measurement during testing.

Accredited Educational Farm for schools, families, and vocational training;

Social Farm and Animal-Assisted Interventions (AAI);

Environmental education and urban climate action projects;

Development of energy communities and local food supply chains.

GROW UP adheres to the Disability Agenda, promotes the One Health approach, and participates in local and European networks in the fields of agroecology, social innovation, and environmental sustainability.

Remote sensing is heavily used by Cesbio scientists to monitor the evolution of the planet at various scales and develop models to tackle societal challenges on biodiversity, climate change, food security, water resources, etc. The laboratory also contributes to the development and promotion of Earth Observation by participating in the definition, implementation and scientific exploitation of space missions.
CESBIO is a joint research unit with:
- National Centre for Space Studies (CNES)
- National Center for Scientific Research (CNRS)
- Research Institute for Development (IRD)
- University Toulouse 3 Paul Sabatier (UT3)
- National Institute of Research for agriculture, food and environment (INRAE)
CESBIO is part of the Midi Pyrénées Observatory.

entityDescription: Our private company entitled EDGE - «EDGE IN EARTH OBSERVATION SCIENCES» was established by statute on 25/09/2018 with base in Athens, Greece. It was registered in the General Commercial Registry with G.E.MΙ. number 147850301000 on 17/10/2018, and Tax Number EL-801049317.EDGE focuses on the provision of EO derived services, supporting also entities (e.g. Institutes, organizations) to exploit their expertise and developed capacities. EDGE is a Research and Consulting company focusing in integrating cutting-edge approaches and technologies, to provide international stakeholders with optimized operational tools and policy-makers with efficient and synthetic information towards fulfilling the aspirations of major global agreements, such as the Sendai Framework on Disaster Risk Reduction, the Paris Agreement and the 2030 Agenda and the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals. Some of the sectors that we focus on: Disasters: Monitoring disastrous phenomena before and after an event, including flood modelling, flood extent monitoring and mapping, flood modelling, geophysical hazards, monitoring of critical infrastructure, early warning of vector transmitted diseases as well as designing the appropriate mitigation measures. Agriculture: Advanced technical capacities in the development of tailored Earth Observation based services for agriculture monitoring, addressing the diverse thematic areas of food security, monitoring of the Common Agricultural Policy and smart/precision farming. Production of state-of-the-art algorithms as well as machine learning and AI techniques. Climate: Integrated atmospheric models provide forecasting services related to natural environmental disasters, such as smoke dispersion associated with forest fires, volcanic ash advection and desert dust outbreaks. Energy: Studies related to nowcasting systems and short-termforecasting systems. Capacity Building: Experience record and expertise in all the managerial aspects along with the required excellence for the organization of numerous successful capacity building actions, workshops and user oriented training seminars. Awareness Raising: Activities related to market analysis, definition of business models, drafting business plans, proposal writing, Intellectual Property Management, Commercialization of research via technical co-design of EO products and applications with the dissemination on state-of-the-art solutions for a broad range of domains, integrating scientific, social and economic values. Communication: EDGE’s vision is to make all kinds of scientific applications reach their real market.

description:
Martel is a dynamic digital innovation agency with 30 years’ experience empowering organisations across Europe and worldwide throughout their journey from novel ideas to technological implementation, media and market strategy. 
After more than two hundred cutting-edge projects, Martel has grown from its origins as a small consulting agency into a thriving organisation with offices in Switzerland and in the Netherlands. 
Building on its foundation in the management of European Commission funded projects and EU consulting, Martel’s business has diversified to include research and development activities in several advanced domains, but also a broad palette of communication, marketing, media and training services. With a skilled and passionate international team, Martel helps its customers and partners achieve ambitious innovation goals in an impactful and sustainable way. 
Martel offers support and guidance spanning from securing funds and providing expertise in selected ICT domains, to strategic communication, marketing and engagement plans. Martel also offers dedicated training on European funding rules and mechanisms, on media and communication for science and technology, and on advanced topics in Cloud Computing, Edge Computing, Internet of Things, Artificial Intelligence, Non-Terrestrial-Networks, Network Virtualisation and open-source Software Engineering.

entityName: SIQ (Slovenian Institute for quality and metrology)
description:
SIQ is a professional, independent, and impartial institution that provides comprehensive solutions in the fields of product testing and certification, management system assessment, metrology, and education. The international recognition and professional level of our work are confirmed by numerous accreditations and memberships in international certification schemes and associations. We are a notified body for seven directives and two regulations. Our team consists of 184 employees and over 350 external expert collaborators, ensuring a high level of expertise and competence in standardization, inspection, testing, control, and verification. 
The entire list of accreditations and technical competences can be found on following link: https://www.siq.si/en/about-us/competences/

We actively conduct testing and compliance assessments for products and components across various industries, including automotive, medical, electronics, machinery, and laboratory and measurement equipment. More than 100 highly qualified testing engineers perform daily tests in electrical safety, electromagnetic compatibility, radio measurements, and climatic/mechanical impacts. Within our accredited scope, we cover more than 500 different standards and are part of international certification schemes, meaning our reports have global recognition. In terms of the number of issued international certificates, we rank in the top quarter of testing laboratories worldwide.
(https://www.siq.si/en/our-services/testing-and-certification-of-products/about-us/)

We conduct assessments and certifications of processes, organizations, and companies according to various international ISO standards. We cover a wide range of areas, including quality management systems (ISO 9001, AQAP), information security management systems (ISO 27001, ISO 22301), environmental management (ISO 14001), energy management systems (ISO 50001), and more. SIQ is an accredited body for management system certification and carbon footprint verification. Our certification portfolio also includes NATO AQAP standards for quality management. (https://www.siq.si/en/our-services/organization-certification/about-us/)

Additionally, in our offering there are also calibration services for various measuring equipment, ranging from simple scales and gauges to voltage/current meters and complex high-frequency devices for measuring radio interference and electromagnetic waves. Our department also engages in strong research activities, focusing on the development of new measurement methods and procedures, and we regularly participate in European development projects. (https://www.siq.si/en/our-services/calibration-and-inspection/about-us/)

As a hub of expertise and competencies, we have established a training department that provides professional education, competence development, and training in various technical fields. We offer specialized training programs in information security, quality management, and management systems. (https://www.siq.si/en/training/about-us/)

In our scope we also provide cybersecurity services, including penetration testing, security assessments of networks, applications, and systems, as well as audit reviews and compliance assessments based on various standards and regulations. Within our accredited scope, we conduct security evaluations of connected (IoT) devices.
(https://www.siq.si/en/our-services/information-technologies/overview/)

Furthermore, we have a dedicated department for testing and verifying equipment intended for installation in potentially explosive environments, ensuring compliance with European regulations. (https://www.siq.si/en/our-services/explosion-protection/about-us/)

entityDescription:
AndroMach is a pioneering French aerospace company developing autonomous spaceplanes to enable in-orbit manufacturing and advanced research in microgravity. Our mission is to provide a cost-effective and reusable platform for producing high-value materials in space while accelerating access to microgravity for scientific and industrial applications. 
Our flagship product is an automated orbital shuttle (100kg payload), designed to serve as a fully reusable in-space manufacturing platform. This vehicle will enable the production of high-value-added materials in LEO and return them to Earth efficiently. By leveraging automation and reusability, we aim to revolutionize space-based production, unlocking new opportunities in medicine and advanced materials manufacturing.
To pave the way for this vision, AndroMach is developing a suborbital demonstrator that will validate key technologies required for the orbital shuttle. This vehicle will be capable of taking off and landing on a runway while offering a phase of microgravity (5min), a capability never before realized. The demonstrator will serve as a testbed for flight systems, aerodynamics, and propulsion, while also offering commercial opportunities for short-duration microgravity experiments and aerospace technology validation (10-30kg payload).
